<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def sq(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']>=10 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return o
print('start:', sq(current_frame))
for i in range(2):
    r=action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
    print(f'after LEFT {i+1}:', sq(current_frame), 'no_impact=',last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): break
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
# player cols
mcols=[c for c in range(64) if a[20][c]=='M']
print('player M cols row20:', min(mcols) if mcols else None, max(mcols) if mcols else None)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
